items.html: And this is also the matter of the bringing out of the sun from its sheath, mentioned in the words of the Sages and in the Tikkunim, that they are HaVaYaH Adonai, as mentioned in Tikkun 21. And the matter is that the sun is ZA, and its sheath is the Nukva, which clothes his NHY, which are harsh judgments, called “the sun within its sheath of the Nukva”; and their force is weakened. And at the going out of the sun from its sheath, as above, it burns the entire world with the harsh judgments. And it was already explained above that this thing is only on weekdays, but on the Shabbatot it was face to face, in the above manner.
